axis_interpretation: axis0=720 trials; axes1-3=(Z=83,Y=104,X=81), REVERSED vs NIfTI (X,Y,Z) per NSD convention. Index a NIfTI voxel (x,y,z) as betas[:, z, y, x]. This is a documented DATA-LAYOUT reversal, NOT spatial resampling.
nan_inf_note: int16 dtype cannot represent NaN/Inf; counts are 0 by construction. NSD betas are stored scaled x300 (documented); convert to signal-change by /300.
full_chunkwise_scan: DEFERRED (1GB); dtype guarantees no NaN/Inf; sample plane stats recorded
